_doc: Overlay hook for vpic_pare_down.py (M2.3 spike). vPIC's US-federal-registration
focus means grey-import / JDM classics with no US VIN history are absent from
the derived picker tables (see README: 'Skyline' is not a model under 'Nissan').
This file is where curated additions for exactly that gap go.
Each entry in 'entries' is merged into the derived make/model/make_model/
model_years tables AFTER the vPIC-derived data, with IDs drawn from a reserved
negative range (assigned at build time) so they can never collide with a real
vPIC id. 'vehicletype' must name one of the kept vehicle types (see script
config KEEP_VEHICLE_TYPES) -- currently: Motorcycle, Passenger Car, Truck,
This spike ships the hook wired up but empty -- 'entries' is intentionally [].
